question: 一共有多少个省份？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 省份数 FROM t_province

question: 商品一共有多少个类目？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_name) AS 类目数 FROM t_product

question: 平台一共有多少个用户？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 用户数 FROM t_user

question: 一共有多少笔订单？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM t_order

question: 当前上架中的商品有多少款？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 上架商品数 FROM t_product WHERE status = 1

question: 订单状态一共有几种？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_status) AS 订单状态数 FROM t_order

question: 各省份销售额排名前5
reference_sql: SELECT p.province_name AS 省份, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS 销售额 FROM t_order o JOIN t_province p ON o.province_id = p.id WHERE o.order_status IN (2,3,4) GROUP BY p.province_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5
notes: 两表关联 + 成交口径 + TopN

question: 各商品类目的销售额和销量排名
reference_sql: SELECT p.category_name AS 商品类目, ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount), 2) AS 销售额, SUM(i.quantity) AS 销量 FROM t_order_item i JOIN t_order o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN t_product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN (2,3,4) GROUP BY p.category_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

question: 最近30天各下单渠道的订单量和实付金额（订单量指全部订单，不按订单状态过滤）
reference_sql: SELECT channel AS 渠道, COUNT(*) AS 订单量, ROUND(SUM(pay_amount), 2) AS 实付金额 FROM t_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 订单量 DESC
notes: 时间窗口 + 分组；明确不做状态过滤

question: 每个会员等级各有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT member_level AS 会员等级, COUNT(*) AS 人数 FROM t_user GROUP BY member_level ORDER BY member_level

question: 各性别的用户数量分别是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT gender AS 性别, COUNT(*) AS 人数 FROM t_user GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender

question: 销量最高的5款商品是哪些？
reference_sql: SELECT i.product_name AS 商品名称, SUM(i.quantity) AS 销量 FROM t_order_item i JOIN t_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN (2,3,4) GROUP BY i.product_name ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 各品牌的商品数量和平均售价
reference_sql: SELECT brand AS 品牌, COUNT(*) AS 商品数, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS 平均售价 FROM t_product GROUP BY brand ORDER BY 商品数 DESC

question: 各订单状态的订单数量和占比（占比为百分比数值，保留2位小数）
reference_sql: SELECT order_status AS 订单状态, COUNT(*) AS 订单量, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order), 2) AS 占比 FROM t_order GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY 订单量 DESC

question: 2026年8月各渠道的订单量是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT channel AS 渠道, COUNT(*) AS 订单量 FROM t_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND create_time < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 订单量 DESC

question: 钻石会员有多少人，他们的成交订单数和客单价分别是多少？（客单价 = 实付金额合计 ÷ 成交订单数）
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS 钻石会员人数, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 成交订单数, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM t_user u JOIN t_order o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.member_level = 4 AND o.order_status IN (2,3,4)
notes: 明确客单价口径为单均价（销售额÷成交订单数）

question: 各商品类目的销售额和成本分别是多少，毛利率是多少？（毛利率为百分比数值，保留2位小数）
reference_sql: SELECT p.category_name AS 商品类目, ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount), 2) AS 销售额, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * p.cost_price), 2) AS 成本, ROUND((SUM(i.item_amount) - SUM(i.quantity * p.cost_price))   / SUM(i.item_amount) * 100, 2) AS 毛利率 FROM t_order_item i JOIN t_order o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN t_product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN (2,3,4) GROUP BY p.category_name ORDER BY 毛利率 DESC
notes: 三表关联 + 派生指标

question: 累计消费金额最高的10个用户，他们分别在哪个省份？
reference_sql: SELECT u.username AS 用户名, ROUND(u.total_amount, 2) AS 累计消费, p.province_name AS 省份 FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_province p ON p.id = u.province_id ORDER BY u.total_amount DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 冗余统计字段 + 关联；二级排序 u.id 保证 Top10 边界确定

question: 每个月的订单量和销售额趋势是怎样的？（销售额按实付金额合计，不按订单状态过滤）
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单量, ROUND(SUM(pay_amount), 2) AS 销售额 FROM t_order GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY 月份
notes: 按月聚合；明确销售额不做状态过滤

question: 有多少用户是复购用户（下过2笔及以上订单，按全部订单统计，不限订单状态）？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 复购用户数 FROM (  SELECT user_id FROM t_order GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) t
notes: HAVING + 子查询；明确不限状态
